name: Rumblings of Discontent
summary: A scout asks you to find a Bolder'ok warrior in a cave west of here. Ogre dissidents seek the freedom their Bolder'ok kin have found.

sections.title: A Scout's Request
sections.body: A scout has found dissidents among the ogres who seek the freedom of their Bolder'ok kin. Word of your deeds has reached the scout, who asks you to find a Bolder'ok warrior in a cave west of here and join his effort to rally his people.

sections.title: A Familiar Name
sections.body: In the cave, the Bolder'ok warrior Crag'rog recognizes you as a fighter for Clugfist.

faq.answer: A Bolder'ok warrior is in a nearby cave west of the scout.

faq.q: Why am I being sent to find him?
faq.answer: The scout asks you to join the warrior's effort to rally the ogres seeking freedom.
Crag'rog is the Bolder'ok warrior in the cave.

faq.q: What do the ogre dissidents want?
faq.answer: The dissidents seek the same freedom as their Bolder'ok kin.

attribution: In-game quest text: Rumblings of Discontent
